runtime_gate.reason: Existing canonical F-host shared-runner heartbeat remains stale and height_difference_2 guarded operator recovery remains unexecuted.

score_basis: Non-statistical internal evidence-quality score based on current official GLA/TfL/LBBD readback, adopted/emerging status separation, transport-operation evidence and explicit prevention of strategic regeneration capacity being promoted to parcel-level capacity.

sources.label: GLA London Riverside Opportunity Area
sources.fact: Barking and Dagenham; OA designated 2004; adopted boundary/policy status; London Riverside OAPF 2015; Barking Riverside Overground extension listed as key transport project; AMR 2018 category Ready to Grow.

sources.label: GLA Opportunity Area locations
sources.fact: Adopted, emerging and to-be-defined OA boundary states are explicitly distinguished; local planning authority documents remain the most up-to-date source for boundaries, capacities, phasing and delivery dates.

sources.label: GLA London's Opportunity Areas
sources.fact: Opportunity Areas are strategic locations for homes, jobs and infrastructure; delivery commonly depends on transport, utilities, social infrastructure and digital connectivity.

sources.label: TfL Improving London Overground
sources.fact: Barking Riverside station opened July 2022; 4.5 km extension connects to Barking in 7 minutes and central London in as little as 22 minutes; development has permission for more than 10,000 homes.

sources.label: TfL Barking Riverside station
sources.fact: Current TfL stop page confirms Barking Riverside is an operating Suffragette line station at River Road, IG11 0BF.

sources.label: TfL London Overground timetables
sources.fact: Current published timetable set includes the Suffragette line Gospel Oak to Barking Riverside service.

sources.label: LBBD Thames Road SPD
sources.fact: Thames Road Vision and Design Code SPD was adopted 14 May 2025 and is a material consideration for regeneration of Thames Road.

sources.label: LBBD Development Plan
sources.fact: Current Development Plan includes London Plan 2021, Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037 and Joint Waste Development Plan; Local Plan 2037 adopted 18 September 2024.

sources.label: LBBD Barking Riverside planning obligations summary
sources.fact: Historic outline obligations include dwelling-triggered transport, education and other infrastructure requirements; these are site-level obligations and not generic parcel entitlements.

sources.label: GLA Barking Riverside Gateways Housing Zone decision
sources.fact: Historic decision records land-assembly funding and phased housing-zone ambitions; historic programme figures are not treated as current parcel-level delivery evidence.

sources.label: LBBD Barking Town Centre Regeneration Strategy
sources.fact: Strategy sets regeneration ambitions and recognises some interventions depend on additional funding and may take longer to deliver.

sources.label: TfL London Overground accessible travel policy
sources.fact: Current policy confirms Barking Riverside opened July 2022 and the route operates four trains per hour from Gospel Oak; transport operation is not proof of individual development completion.

examples.result: London Riverside OA status revalidated as ADOPTED; OA status is strategic planning context, not a parcel permission.
Barking Riverside rail extension revalidated as operational since July 2022; operating transport improves accessibility but does not establish parcel development capacity.
Thames Road SPD adoption date revalidated as 14 May 2025; SPD material weight retained without converting it into permission.
LBBD Local Plan 2037 adoption date revalidated as 18 September 2024; adopted plan precedence retained.
Historic Barking Riverside outline obligations retained as site-specific evidence only; no cross-site extrapolation.
Housing-zone historic funding/capacity figures tagged HISTORIC_PROGRAMME_EVIDENCE rather than current completion.
Barking Town Centre strategy funding dependency retained; ambition does not equal funded delivery.
Current TfL station/timetable evidence confirms service operation; no candidate promotion without exact site and parcel geometry.
